content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Madras University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Madras University Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by Madras University?
faq.answer: Madras University has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Research Associate, Research Assistant, and Field Investigator through this walk-in drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate post, candidates must have a Postgraduate degree in a social science discipline or a relevant field (minimum 55%) with NET/M.Phil/Ph.D and two years of experience or two published research papers.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator post offers a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Research Assistant post should be below 40 years of age.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue for Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Madras University, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, 600005. Please refer to the official notification for the exact reporting address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a postgraduate degree in any field apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates must have a Postgraduate degree specifically in a Social Science discipline or a relevant field as per the project requirements.
